annotations.title: Get my Zero to Hundred listing

description: Read one owned listing before editing it. Requires listings:read. Use a slug from z2h_list_my_listings. Returns descriptions, pricing, software attributes, source attachment state and web edit links. Missing listings and listings owned by someone else both return not found. This does not download source code.

slug.description: Identifies one of the authenticated Builder's listings. Copy slug from z2h_list_my_listings or z2h_create_draft_listing.

name: z2h_get_listing

askingPrice.description: USD license price, or null when unset.

documentationLevel.description: Documentation supplied, or null when unset.

editUrl.description: Web wizard URL for editing this listing.

externalDependencies.description: Services the Buyer must provision. Legacy records may contain service names as strings.

note.description: What the service is used for.

maintenanceLevel.description: Builder maintenance commitment, or null when unset.

operatingStatus.description: Operating state of the software, independent of listing publication.

publishUrl.description: Web review step where the Builder finishes publishing.

slug.description: Listing identifier used by the other Builder tools.

sourceCodeIncluded.description: Whether the Builder included source code.

sourceKind.description: Source attachment method, or null before attachment.

status.description: Listing publication state. Only drafts can be edited through MCP.

testEnvInstructions.description: Legacy stored demo instructions, or null.

testEnvUrl.description: Legacy stored demo URL, or null.
